title: I Do... Expose You
logline: A bride turns her fake wedding into a public revenge trap after discovering her groom helped orchestrate the betrayal she planned to expose.
target_audience: US TikTok viewers who binge dark romance, betrayal, public revenge, and twist-heavy serialized drama.
hook: I wasn't marrying him for love. I was marrying him for evidence—until I found his name on the payment that destroyed my sister.
synopsis: Mara agreed to marry Adrian Vale to access evidence that his family framed her sister, Elena. Seconds before the vows, Mara discovers Adrian personally funded the key witness. Instead of fleeing, she hijacks the wedding livestream and exposes him before every guest. Adrian counters with an impossible claim: Elena planned the marriage. Then Elena appears on-screen with a warning.
episode_goal: Reveal the groom's connection to the betrayal, let Mara publicly seize control, and end with conflicting claims that force viewers into the next episode.

characters.name: Mara Reed
characters.description: A controlled, fearless woman who entered a fake marriage to expose the powerful family that ruined her sister.
characters.motivation: Clear Elena's name and make everyone responsible confess publicly.

characters.name: Adrian Vale
characters.description: A magnetic heir who agreed to a loveless marriage while hiding his role in Mara's family scandal.
characters.motivation: Complete his secret deal with Elena while keeping Mara close.

characters.name: Elena Reed
characters.description: The woman at the center of the scandal, presumed gone until she interrupts the wedding remotely.
characters.motivation: Warn Mara before Adrian's hidden plan reaches its final stage.

scenes.purpose: Open with the fake-marriage contradiction and reveal Adrian's link to Elena's betrayal.
scenes.setting: Wedding aisle, moments before the ceremony
scenes.beat_summary: Mara walks toward Adrian while checking the final evidence file on her phone. A payment record identifies Adrian as the man who funded the witness against Elena.
scenes.emotional_objective: Make viewers question whether Mara will run, submit, or strike back.
character_actions: Mara advances down the aisle without breaking eye contact.
She opens the payment record hidden behind her bouquet.
She removes her engagement ring before reaching Adrian.
scenes.turning_point: Mara sees Adrian's verified signature on the transaction and decides to continue the ceremony.

dialogues.text: I wasn't marrying him for love.
I was marrying him for evidence.

scenes.purpose: Give Mara visible agency by turning the ceremony and livestream into her revenge trap.
scenes.setting: Wedding altar beneath a wall-sized livestream screen
scenes.beat_summary: Asked to say her vows, Mara refuses. She triggers a preloaded presentation showing Adrian's payment record to the guests and thousands watching online.
scenes.emotional_objective: Deliver the revenge payoff while preserving doubt about Adrian's true motive.
character_actions: She taps her ring, activating the livestream evidence package.
She turns the screen toward Adrian and demands an answer.
scenes.turning_point: Adrian remains calm and claims Mara has exposed only half the truth.

dialogues.text: But I do have a wedding gift.

scenes.purpose: Reverse the revenge reveal and end on a direct warning from Elena.
scenes.setting: Wedding altar as the hacked screen flickers
scenes.beat_summary: Adrian claims Elena hired him to arrange the marriage and her own disappearance. Before he can explain, Elena takes over the livestream and urgently contradicts him. A public reveal flips the power balance while one decisive answer remains withheld.
scenes.emotional_objective: Force viewers to choose whom Mara should trust and demand the next episode.
character_actions: Adrian steps closer but does not touch Mara.
He shows her a message carrying Elena's private code.
The wedding screen abruptly switches to Elena's live feed.
Mara raises the microphone and confronts both of them.
scenes.turning_point: Elena appears alive and warns Mara that Adrian's story is a lie.

dialogues.text: Elena hired me to marry you.

next_episode_question: What did Adrian secretly change on the marriage license—and why is Elena terrified that Mara has already signed it?
